scope: Source-level C++ cache/window port; independent conservative sphere culler and retained-sector range selector. Not a complete client conversion.
adaptations: Metres, X/Z ground plane and double-precision coordinates
Unclamped signed local grid instead of WoW ADT tile coordinates
Explicit bounded LRU capacity overrides 30-second dwell
Camera-independent AABB residency preserves camera rotation and upload pacing
Generic sphere visibility only; portal/PVS logic is not ported

dependencies.port: C++17 standard library; C ABI into existing PySide6/Qt Quick 3D
